verdict.rationale: Orama's GitHub feature list names "Pinning Rules (Merchandising)", which covers the pin part of query-specific result curation. "Fields Boosting" appears to be field-level weighting, not boosting specific hits for specific queries. Both are bare feature-list mentions with no documentation of how they work. Missing for 10: synonym definition, hiding/excluding specific hits per query, per-query hit boosting, in-depth docs on pinning rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can define synonyms and curate results — pin, boost, or hide specific hits for specific queries
